content.rendered:
Coyote Country club – 1 Coyote Creek Golf Dr, Morgan Hill, CA 95037

6-12

5:15 – Start
Background Music
Claude Debussy Clair De Lune
Manuel Barrueco Granada from Suite Espanola
Francisco Tarrega Gran Vals
Antonio Vivaldi Spring from The Four Seasons
?Tchaikovsky The Nutcracker – Waltz of the Flowers
Claude Debussy The Girl with the Flaxen Hair

6:00pm
Seating of the parents-Officiant – Groomsman March ?

Wedding Party March-Flower Girl- Ring Bearer – Maid of Honor
Coldplay Sparks

. Processional : Bride Walks Down the Aisle with her Father “Here Comes the Bride”
L’Orchestra Cinematique The Moon Song

Recessional Bride and Groom are Married Hitched Special Moments that Last Forever!
Frank Sinatra Come Fly with Me

_______________________________________________

GRAND ENTRANCE
• 6:35pm – 7:30pm – Mostly Rat Pack music during cocktail hour

• 7:30pm – 8:45pm – Lead guest to the reception room for dinner and music

Dean Martin Ain’t That a Kick in the Head

Dinner
Coldplay Magic
Coldplay Green Eyes
Ray LaMontagne I Still Care for You
Nat King Cole L-O-V-E
Billie Holiday You’re My Thrill
Billie Holiday I’ll Be Seeing You
Billie Holiday The Very Thought of You
Ella Fitzgerald & Louis Armstrong Dream a Little Dream of Me
Norah Jones Don’t Know Why
Norah Jones Sunshine
Frank Sinatra The Way You Look Tonight

• 8:45- 9:15pm: Announce cutting of the cake. Louis Armstrong – La Vie En Rose

• 9:15pm- 9:20pm – Announce First dance, Harvest Moon by Neil Young, invite guest to use

sparklers

9:20pm – 10pm: Announce Dance:

Father/Daughter
Louis Armstrong What a Wonderful World

Mother/Son
Rascal Flatts My Wish

• 10pm – 11:30pm: Announce Dancing! Bride and Groom leave at 11:30pm

First Song right after Bride and Groom 1st Dacne?

Elvis Presley Can’t Help Falling in Love
Frankie Valli Can’t Take My Eyes Off You
James Brown Get Up Offa That Thing
Curtis Mayfield Move on Up
Bill Withers Just The Two of Us
Al Green Let’s Stay Together
Marvin Gaye Let’s Get it On
The Isley Brothers Twist and Shout
House of Pain Jump Around
Neil Diamond Sweet Caroline
Stromae Alors on Danse
Cali Swag District Teach Me How to Dougie
Calvin Harris Feel So Close
Ice Cube It Was a Good Day
LMFAO Party Rock Anthem
Toby Keith Red Solo Cup

Last Song as Bride and Groom Leave
Marvin Gaye Let’s Get it On

Last Song of the Night
Adele Skyfall

11:30pm – 12:00pm – Final guest leave, music is ending

DO NOT PLAY
Linda Ronstadt I Love you for Sentimental Reasons
Jimmy Buffet Maragaritaville
Sade Sweetest Taboo
Anita Baker You Bring Me Joy

DO NOT PLAY
